paragraphs: Omnitracs sells fleet management software for transportation fleets, organised around a platform it calls Omnitracs One. The platform page describes one place for drivers, teams in the field, and the back office to work from a single source of truth. Functions named on the solutions page include driver workflow, data and document submission, communications, and vehicle inspection reporting.

Routing sits alongside that, sold as connected solutions for routing, dispatch, and driver experience. Video safety is a second line, described as storage in the cloud plus artificial intelligence that picks out the video moments a fleet needs to see.

The customers these pages name are commercial carriers and distributors, among them Dayton Freight Lines and Palmer-Donavin. Buyers are otherwise described in the pages' own terms as delivery and service fleets. The about page dates the company to 1998, when it was formed as a division of Qualcomm to track assets and communicate with drivers.

quote.text: Save time and fuel while improving your customer experience with connected solutions for routing, dispatch, and driver experience.
